name: TensorProduct.sum_tmul_basis_right_injective
statement: Function.Injective (Finsupp.lsum R fun i ↦ (TensorProduct.mk R M N).flip (𝒞 i))

name: TensorProduct.sum_tmul_basis_right_eq_zero
statement: κ →₀ M) (h : (b.sum fun i m ↦ m ⊗ₜ[R] 𝒞 i) = 0) : b = 0

name: TensorProduct.sum_tmul_basis_left_injective
statement: Function.Injective (Finsupp.lsum R fun i ↦ (TensorProduct.mk R M N) (ℬ i))

name: TensorProduct.sum_tmul_basis_left_eq_zero
statement: ι →₀ N) (h : (b.sum fun i n ↦ ℬ i ⊗ₜ[R] n) = 0) : b = 0
